request: how are stack frames pushed and popped in recursion?

composition.story: Recursive calls push new activation frames onto the call stack, allocating local variables. Reaching the base case halts descent, and returning pops frames one by one while computing results.

aha.observation: Base case reached, top frame starts popping and returning values downward.

states.label: Push f(3)
states.sentence: Initial call pushes f(3) onto the stack.

states.label: Push f(2)
states.sentence: f(3) calls f(2), pushing a new frame.

states.label: Push f(1)
states.sentence: f(2) calls f(1), pushing another frame.

states.label: Base Case
states.sentence: f(1) calls f(0), hitting the base case.

states.label: Pop f(0)
states.sentence: Base case returns 1, popping f(0) off.

states.label: Pop f(1)
states.sentence: f(1) completes and pops off the stack.

states.label: Pop f(2)
states.sentence: f(2) completes and pops off the stack.

1.reason: Stack frames appearing and disappearing show how the call stack grows to the base case and then unwinds.
